ingestion_rules: Store evidence_class with every imported dataset and derived result.
Do not combine simulated network states and physical tracer observations into one leaderboard.
Record version, licence, source digest, geometry identity, operating regime and transformation receipts.
Use whole-network, whole-geometry, whole-facility and whole-scale holdouts where supported.
Record missing data and access conditions; do not infer open reproducibility from an abstract.
